## Goal mode
- A goal that answers 3 turns in a row without using any tool is now paused, instead of looping and burning tokens. Resume it by sending a message in Goal mode.

## Rate limits (429)
- When the provider says "too many requests", the agent now waits and retries on its own instead of failing after a few seconds: up to 8 tries, from 5 s up to 5 min between tries.
- The provider's `Retry-After` delay is respected.
- The chat shows "Rate limited, retrying at …" while waiting. Stop cancels the wait right away.

## Known limits
- Both changes are covered by unit tests but have not been checked by hand in the app yet.
